title: Government Clears ₹7,877-Crore Electronics Components Projects

blocks.content: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology approved 31 project proposals under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme on 17 August 2026. The projects involve an investment of ₹7,877 crore across 10 Indian states and are linked with an expected production output of ₹82,243 crore and nearly 10,000 direct jobs.

items: Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme is a central scheme linked to the electronics manufacturing ecosystem in India.
MeitY stands for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
Copper-clad laminates are used in printed circuit boards and other electronic applications.
Electronic capital goods include machinery and equipment used in electronics production.
